faq.q: What does Nama mean in Persian?

faq.q: What are the variants of Nama?
faq.a: Romanization variants include Nama, nama. Script forms are نماء, نَمَاء, नमा.

faq.q: Is Nama a boy's or girl's name?
faq.a: Documented usage records this form as female. Gender is not inferred from the meaning of the word, and actual use may vary between communities.
